children: said on Tuesday that its wholly owned subsidiary, Pioneer Natural Resources, expects to purchase ~$1.19B of outstanding senior notes for cash through

The offers cover $1.1B of 1.900% senior notes due 2030 and $1B of 2.150% senior notes due 2031. Holders tendered $570.36M of the 2030 notes and $615.6M of the 2031 notes, which the company expects to accept for purchase.

The total consideration is $888.49 per $1K principal amount for the 2030 notes and $885.66 per $1K for the 2031 notes. Holders will also receive accrued and unpaid interest through the settlement date.
ExxonMobil expects to complete the purchases on September 16. Interest will stop accruing on the settlement date, and the purchased notes will be cancelled.
